entries.label: Version 1
entries.prompt:
Design a clickable, high-fidelity prototype of "gtmworks": a workspace where a marketing team talks to its AI agents like teammates and watches them work on a marketing board. Arabic first (dir="rtl", Egyptian/Saudi marketer copy), English only for product and tool names.

Reference for the look and the conversation experience (read only, do not copy logos or the pink brand): the Grok Bot clone source at /home/omar/workspace/design/grokbot-clone/web/src (layout in components/Sidebar.tsx, ChatView.tsx, Transcript.tsx, Composer.tsx, DetailsPanel.tsx, MembersCard.tsx, cards/Cards.tsx; colours and spacing in styles/tokens.css). Keep its calm, near-monochrome, roomy feel: light sidebar, white pane, one accent colour (pick a confident teal or indigo for gtmworks, not pink).

Screens, all in one prototype with working navigation between them:
1. Chat with an agent (the heart, closest to Grok Bot): sidebar with the workspace, a "New chat" button, the agents (Ads, SEO & Content, Analyst, Critic) each with a face and a status dot, recent threads. Centre: a thread with the Ads agent planning a Meta campaign for an accounting course ("المحاسب الشامل"): streamed reply, a collapsible "steps" line showing tool use, an approval card (allow once / always allow / don't allow) before it launches the campaign, a choice card with 3 ad angles. Composer at the bottom with @ for agents and / for commands, model picker. Right details panel: the agent, its connections (Meta Ads, Google Ads, GA4), its routines, files.
2. Marketing board: a kanban board (Ideas, Planned, In progress, Waiting on you, Live, Done) with cards like "Meta campaign: المحاسب الشامل", "SEO article: كورس محاسبة اونلاين", "Weekly report". Each card shows the agent working on it, a live progress line, and a "Waiting on you" badge when an agent needs approval. Clicking a card opens its thread in a side sheet: the same conversation as screen 1, so you can talk to the agent from the card.
3. Marketing dashboard: spend, leads, cost per lead, revenue for the last 7 and 30 days, by channel (Meta, Google, SEO), a short "what the agents did this week" feed, and the cards waiting on you.

Make it feel like a real shipped product, not a mock: realistic Arabic data, empty and loading states where natural, desktop width 1440 first.

This round:

The company now has a team of people, not one person. Omar settled these decisions; design them exactly, and do not add options he did not choose.

0. A way to see the prototype as different people. Add a small "شايف كـ" switcher in the account menu with three people of the same company: the Owner (عمر، مالك), a media buyer (مساهم، allowed Ads and Analyst only) and a viewer (مشاهد). Everything below changes with the person chosen. This switcher is a prototype aid only; mark it so in small text.

1. Company agents are shared. The company has one set of agents and one memory for all members; no member owns a private agent. Only the Owner and a Manager can change an agent's settings; for everyone else the agent settings screen is read only, with one line that says who can change it.

2. Each member sees only the agents they are allowed to work with. The Owner or a Manager chooses them per member, in a new part of the team/members settings: one row per member with their role and a toggle for each agent. An agent the member is not allowed is not shown to them at all: not in the sidebar, not in the "+" menus, not in mentions, not locked or greyed. As the media buyer, the sidebar shows only the main agent, Ads and Analyst.

3. The main agent, done the way Grok Bot does it (rows G11 and "Make primary" in the reference). The Owner marks one of the company's existing agents as the main one ("خلّيه الرئيسي" in that agent's settings, Owner only); exactly one agent is main at a time. The main agent is shown first in the agent list with a small "الرئيسي" mark, every member always sees it, and it cannot be hidden from anyone. It is the front door: its empty chat says it is the main point of contact and passes work to the right agent, and it sends the morning message.

4. Handoff from the main agent stays inside the same conversation and inside the member's permissions. When the work belongs to another agent, a handoff line shows in the same conversation ("اتسلّم لـ Ads") and that agent continues the reply there; no new conversation opens. The main agent only hands to agents this member is allowed. Show the other case too, as the media buyer: the work needs SEO & Content, so the main agent says that agent is not available to them and offers to ask the manager.

5. A new agent is proposed by the main agent and created only when the Owner approves. Any member except a viewer can ask the main agent for a new agent in chat. The main agent prepares a proposal card in the conversation: name, job, instructions, the tools and apps it would get, the model, which members would see it, and who asked and why. The proposal appears to the Owner in "مستنيك" with three actions: "وافق", "عدّل وبعدين وافق" (opens the same fields to edit) and "ارفض" with a reason. Until the Owner answers there is no agent: the asker sees "مستني موافقة المالك". After approval the agent appears in the list for the members named; after a refusal the asker sees the reason. Show the whole flow clickable: ask as the media buyer, approve as the Owner.

Viewer: reads everything their role allows and cannot write, ask, approve or change anything; show their controls absent, not disabled, with one quiet line that explains it.

This round:

This round builds on the previous one (several people in one company, the "شايف كـ" switcher, the main agent). Omar settled these decisions; design them exactly.

1. One log, shown in three places. The company has a single record of what happened. Show it (a) under every card on the marketing board, as a "السجل" section, (b) on every agent's page, as that agent's entries, and (c) as a company page "سجل النشاط" reached from the sidebar, newest first, with filters by person or agent and by card.
   - Automatic entries: every change writes one line by itself, with who did it (a person, an agent, or gtmworks for system actions), what changed (old value to new value where there is one) and when. Examples: a stage moved, a version delivered, an approval given or refused, an agent's settings changed, a member's allowed agents changed, a channel created, a new agent approved.
   - Notes: members write notes in the log under a card, and can mention a member or an agent with @. A note can be edited by its writer for 5 minutes only; after that it is locked for good. An edited note carries a small "اتعدّلت" mark. Nothing in the log can be deleted, by anyone. Show a note still inside its 5 minutes (with the edit control and the time left) and one that is locked.
   - A mention of an agent in a note is a real request: the agent works on it and answers with its own note in the same log (show the "شغال" state, then the answer). A mention of a member appears for that member in "مستنيك".
   - A viewer reads the log and cannot write a note.

2. Channels. A channel is a team conversation: members and agents write in the same thread. There is no separate people-only chat.
   - Every company has a channel "عام" with all its members. The Owner or a Manager creates other channels (for a campaign or a department) and chooses which members and which agents are in each; other members cannot create a channel. Show the create flow and the channel's members panel.
   - Channels get their own group in the sidebar, above the conversations, each with an unread count. The existing team thread ("حملة ديسمبر · فريق") becomes a channel; keep its content and handoff lines.
   - An agent in a channel reads and answers only when someone mentions it by name; ordinary talk between members goes to no agent. Replace the old hint "من غير @ الكل يرد" with one that says this. Show members talking with no agent answering, then a mention and the agent's answer.
   - Inside a channel, every member of it can see and mention the channel's agents, even an agent that is hidden from that member elsewhere. Outside the channel nothing changes for them: the agent stays hidden and they cannot open a private conversation with it. Show this as the media buyer in a channel that has Critic.
   - A private conversation between one member and an agent stays private, as it is now.
   - A viewer reads channels they are in and cannot write.

3. Notifications live inside gtmworks only in this version: the unread count beside each channel and conversation, and "مستنيك", which now also lists mentions of me (from a channel or a log note) and, for the Owner, new-agent proposals. No email, no phone notification, no WhatsApp; do not design settings for them.

Check each of these as the Owner, the media buyer and the viewer.

This round:

This round builds on the two before it (several people in one company, the "شايف كـ" switcher, the main agent, the log, channels). Omar decided that one product serves both a person working alone and a team. It is one system: working alone only hides the team parts. Do not design a second layout.

1. One question at first run. Add a first-run step that asks "هتشتغل لوحدك ولا مع تيم؟" with two choices, each with one line that says what it means. Make the first run reachable in the prototype (an entry in the account menu, marked as a prototype aid).
   - "مع تيم": the next step is inviting members (email and role for each, skippable), then the workspace opens with everything from the previous two rounds.
   - "لوحدي": the workspace opens straight away, with the team parts hidden.

2. What working alone hides. In the same screens, with no gaps left behind: the channels group in the sidebar and channel creation, the per-member allowed-agents settings, the "who would see it" field in a new-agent proposal, and every "which members" choice. Everything else stays: all agents are visible, conversations, the board, the numbers, the log under cards and on agent pages, and the company activity page (the person still needs to see what the agents did).

3. A new agent when working alone. The person is the Owner, so there is no waiting on someone else: the main agent's proposal card shows in the conversation with "وافق", "عدّل وبعدين وافق" and "ارفض" right there, and the agent is created on approval. No agent is ever created without that click.

4. Becoming a team later. The team settings stay reachable when working alone, with an "اعزم عضو" action and one line that says inviting someone turns on channels and per-member agents. After the first member is invited, the team parts appear by themselves, with the "عام" channel already there and all existing conversations, cards and log entries unchanged. Show this switch clickable. There is no way back to "alone" while other members exist; do not design one.

5. Add "لوحدي (مالك)" to the "شايف كـ" switcher, so the four views are: alone, Owner in a team, media buyer, viewer.

This round:

This round builds on the three before it (team, main agent, log, channels, alone or team). Omar decided that nobody ever has to open the engine behind gtmworks to set anything: every setting is reachable inside gtmworks. Never show the engine's name, file names or paths in the UI; use plain Egyptian Arabic names.

1. One settings overlay. A full settings page that opens as an overlay over the workspace (like a desktop app's settings: a list of sections on one side, the section's content beside it, close returns to where the person was). Open it from the account menu and from the gear. Sections: الشركة (name, alone or team, members), الوكلاء (the list, each opening that agent's existing settings inside the overlay), معرفة الشركة, التعلّم, الاشتراك والموديلات (the company's connected AI subscription, default model, effort), التطبيقات (the existing connect-apps catalogue), المهام المتكررة (all routines across agents), الاستهلاك (token use per agent), النسخ الاحتياطي. Reuse the screens that already exist in the prototype; do not redesign them, place them in the overlay. The Owner and a Manager can change; other roles see what their role allows, read only; a viewer does not see the overlay's company sections.

2. Company knowledge ("معرفة الشركة"). A shared set of pages that every agent of the company reads: صوت البراند, الجمهور, المنتجات والأسعار, الممنوع (banned claims), القرارات. Each is a page a person can read and edit, with who changed it last and when. Make it clear how it differs from an agent's own memory: company knowledge is shared by all agents; an agent's memory tab stays that agent's own. In an agent's memory tab, add one line that links to company knowledge, and on each memory note show which member it came from when it came from a person.

3. Learning setup ("التعلّم"). Agents improve by themselves: they save memory notes and write or improve their own skills from the work. Show this as a setting per company with a per-agent override: "يتعلّم لوحده" (saves by itself, each save is written in the log) or "يستأذن الأول" (each new note or skill waits as a proposal for a person). Show the list of what agents learned recently (note or skill, which agent, from which conversation, when) with "انسى ده" for a note and "رجّع النسخة اللي قبلها" for a skill. Show a skill improved by an agent: before and after, readable.

4. An agent changes its own settings, inside limits. Omar's rule:
   - Without permission, written in the log: its own memory notes and the skills it learned.
   - Only with the Owner's approval: its model, its tools, its connected apps and its core instructions. The agent proposes the change in the conversation as a card (what changes, from what to what, why), it appears to the Owner in "مستنيك" with وافق / عدّل وبعدين وافق / ارفض, and nothing changes until then.
   - The main agent can propose such a change for any other agent, by the same rule.
   Show both cases clickable: an agent that learned a skill by itself (log entry), and an agent asking for a new tool (proposal, then approval as the Owner). When working alone, the approval is right there in the conversation, as with a new agent.

5. First run: confirm it asks only "لوحدك ولا مع تيم". It does not ask for a job or a role type. The media buyer in the "شايف كـ" switcher is only an example member, never an account type.

Check as alone, Owner in a team, media buyer and viewer, in light and dark.

This round:

This round builds on the four before it. Omar decided that a company can also run its software work in gtmworks, through a coding agent, later in the rollout. Design only what a person sees; never show the engine's name. Keep marketing the main story of the prototype: the coding agent is one more agent, not a second product.

1. A coding agent in the agent list ("Coder"), offered from the private agent gallery, not there by default. Like every agent it is shown only to members allowed to see it. Its empty chat says what it does: it builds a change from a written request, tests it, opens a merge request and stops; it never merges or deploys by itself.

2. A code card on the same board, beside marketing cards, with a small type mark so the two kinds are told apart at a glance. Its stages use the board's existing stages; do not add a second board. The card shows, in plain Egyptian Arabic: the request (what and why, with its acceptance points as a checklist), who is building it (the agent), the merge request link, the tests state (شغالة / نجحت / وقعت, with the name of the test that failed), the review state (مستني مراجعة / فيه ملاحظات N / اتراجع), and the merge state (مستني / اندمج, with when). A sensitive change carries a "حساس" mark and says it waits for an extra review.

3. When it needs the person. A blocked code card shows one plain question from the agent with an answer field, appears in "مستنيك", and continues after the answer. Show one such card.

4. The log under a code card uses the same log as every card: started, merge request opened, tests failed then passed, review notes, merged; each with who and when.

5. A filter on the board: الكل / تسويق / كود. A viewer reads code cards and cannot answer or change them. When working alone it is the same card.

Use realistic RS Learning examples (e.g. "زرار الدفع في صفحة الحجز على الموبايل"), 4 or 5 code cards across the stages: one building, one with failed tests, one waiting on the person, one merged. Check in light and dark.

This round:

This round builds on the nine before it and changes how agents come to exist. Omar decided it works as in Grok Bot: the workspace starts with the main agent alone, and the person gets a new agent by asking the main agent in plain words. Design only what a person sees; never show the engine's name. Keep everything already approved that this round does not name.

1. First run. After choosing alone or team, the person lands in one conversation with the main agent (Lead) and nothing else: no other agents, an empty board, one short line saying what Lead is for and that they can ask it for an agent for any job. No wizard, no gallery, no form. "أول تشغيل" in the account menu must show this real empty start.

2. Making an agent by talking. Show one full example in Lead's chat: the Owner writes something like «عايز حد يمسك إعلانات Meta وGoogle»; Lead answers in a sentence or two, asks at most one question if it truly needs it, then creates the agent at once. A card in the chat shows what it made: name, job in one line, the apps it will use, what it will never do without asking (publish, spend, message a customer). The new agent appears in the agent list immediately, with a "جديد" mark, and the Owner can open it and give it work. No approve step when the Owner asked.

3. When a member who is not the Owner asks Lead for an agent, nothing is created: Lead prepares the same card as a request and it goes to the Owner's "مستنيك" (this already exists; keep it and make the two cases look clearly different). A viewer cannot ask.

4. "وكيل جديد" in the sidebar opens Lead's chat with the composer focused and a hint line, instead of a form or gallery. Keep the gallery as a small secondary link ("أو اختار من الجاهزين"), not the main way.

5. Changing an agent by talking. In any agent's chat show one example: the Owner writes a lasting rule («من دلوقتي ما تبعتش حاجة للعميل من غير ما أشوفها»), the agent confirms and a small "اتحفظت" line appears, and it is written in the log. The settings overlay's agents section stays as a place to see each agent's setup, with one line saying the simplest way to change an agent is to tell it.

6. Private chats and team learning. In team mode, a member's direct chat with an agent is private to that member: say so in one quiet line at the top of the chat ("المحادثة دي بينك وبين Ads بس"). Shared work stays in channels and on cards. When a member teaches an agent something for the team, the agent says it will suggest it, and it appears under "اقتراحات التعلّم" for the Owner or a Manager to approve or refuse; what the Owner or a Manager teaches applies at once. Remove any screen where one member reads another member's direct chat with an agent.

7. The demo state. Keep the current populated company (Lead plus the agents it made over a few weeks) as the default view so every screen stays reviewable, and make each agent's page show "اتعمل يوم … بطلب من …". Working alone shows the same idea with fewer agents.

8. Fixes from Hermes's walk of rounds 5 to 9: (a) the composer's extras button says "قناة جديدة" in its label when working alone and for the media buyer; it must not. (b) "شايف كـ" lacks the Manager (سارة); add her so the Manager role can be reviewed. (c) A note should be editable for its 5 minutes from the "سجل النشاط" page too, not only under the card.

Check in light and dark, Arabic and English, and that the four "شايف كـ" views plus the Manager still open with no error.
